hooks.name: Workflow Phase Guide
hooks.description: Identifies the workflow phase from the user's prompt and injects relevant steering rules and next steps before execution begins.

action.prompt:
Before starting work, identify which workflow phase this prompt belongs to and list the MANDATORY steps you must follow:

**If working on DEVELOPMENT SUBTASKS:**
1. Write the code
2. IMMEDIATELY transition the Jira subtask to Done (never leave in To Do)
3. After ALL dev subtasks for a story are done: generate unit test results doc (docs/testing/{ISSUE-KEY}-unit-test-results.md)
4. Upload code coverage doc to the Code Coverage subtask in Jira (attach file + comment + transition to Done)
5. Upload unit test results to the Unit Test subtask in Jira (attach + comment + transition to Done)
6. Then proceed to Code Review subtask

**If working on REQUIREMENT GENERATION:**
1. Apply P5 pre-composition checklist (6 steps)
2. Write the requirement document
3. Save locally as docs/requirements/{ISSUE-KEY}-{title}-requirements.md
4. Attach the .md file to the Requirement Generation subtask in Jira
5. Assign to lead (nagesh) for approval
6. Transition to Pending Approval

**If working on DESIGN DERIVATION:**
1. Verify Requirement Generation subtask is Approved (BLOCK if not)
2. Apply P6 pre-composition checklist (8 steps)
3. Write the design document
4. Save locally as docs/design/{ISSUE-KEY}-{title}-design.md
5. Get user approval in chat
6. Attach the .md file to the Design Derivation subtask in Jira
7. Assign to lead (nagesh) for approval
8. Transition to Pending Approval

**If working on CODE REVIEW:**
1. Run semantic_reviewer on the code changes
2. Save findings to docs/code-review/{ISSUE-KEY}-code-review.md
3. If issues found: fix them, re-run review until clean
4. Attach review doc to Code Review subtask
5. Assign to lead for human review
6. Transition to Pending Approval

**If working on TESTING:**
1. Run end-to-end tests
2. Document results in docs/testing/{ISSUE-KEY}-testing-results.md
3. If issues found: fix → re-review → re-test
4. Attach to Testing subtask
5. Transition to Done

**If ASSIGNING a story:** Also assign ALL subtasks to the same person.

**If creating USER STORIES from BRD:** Follow brd-to-jira.md Phase 1 → Phase 1.5 (mandatory coverage gate) → Phase 2.

State which phase you identified and list the steps you will follow. Do NOT skip any step.
